page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 16 dedicated physical cores with 16 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and the virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of an entry-level NVIDIA P4 GPU makes this instance a specialized option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the premium cost of high-end tensor-core GPUs. However, the lack of local storage and the moderate 3 Gbps network baseline are notable tradeoffs that require careful architectural planning for data-intensive tasks. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as video transcoding, entry-level deep learning inference, and GPU-accelerated web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory at a 1:4 core-to-RAM ratio. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached options, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor. Qualitatively, this configuration offers a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated tasks by utilizing a legacy accelerator, avoiding the higher costs of modern enterprise GPUs. It is suited for workloads such as video transcoding, low-latency inference, and basic parallel computing tasks that do not demand high-speed local storage.
